9:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Player ship
12:   const ship = {
13:     width: 40,
14:     height: 20,
15:     x: WIDTH / 2 - 20,
16:     y: HEIGHT - 30,
17:     speed: 5,
18:     color: '#0ff'
19:   };
20: 
21:   // Meteor pool
22:   const meteors = [];

24:   let lastSpawn = 0;
25:   let lastTime = performance.now();
26:   let score = 0;
27:   let gameOver = false;
28: 
29:   // Input handling
30:   const keys = {};
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
32:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
33: 
34:   function spawnMeteor() {
35:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 10;
36:     meteors.push({
37:       x: Math.random() * (WIDTH - size),
38:       y: -size,
39:       size,
40:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
41:       color: '#f55'
42:     });
43:   }
44: 
45:   function update(dt) {
46:     // Move ship
47:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) ship.x -= ship.speed;
48:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) ship.x += ship.speed;
49:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(WIDTH - ship.width, ship.x));
50:

52:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > meteorSpawnInterval) {
53:       spawnMeteor();
54:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
55:     }

58:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
59:       const m = meteors[i];
60:       m.y += m.speed;

62:       if (m.y > HEIGHT) meteors.splice(i, 1);
